Use this when a blocker is cleared or a planned step is done. The entry then stops showing as open in reports.

## CLI

### gournal resolve

Mark an open blocker or next entry as resolved. Pass the full id or the last 8 characters.

```text
gournal resolve <id>
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `<id>` | yes | The full id or the last 8 characters of the entry. |

## MCP tool

### resolve_entry

Mark an open blocker or next entry as resolved.

#### Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | yes | Full id or the last 8 characters of the open blocker or next entry. |
| `by` | `string` | no | Id of the entry that resolved it. |

#### Output

This tool returns structured output. The shape is the [Entry result](/gournal/docs/reference/output-shapes/#entry-result).

## Examples

### CLI

Resolve an open blocker. Pass the short id from the standup report. The entry then leaves the Blockers list.

```console
$ gournal resolve HTMQYBQ9
✓ Resolved: Cannot reproduce the failing webhook retry in staging

$ gournal standup -p billing-api

Standup: Today (2026-11-15)

  Done
  billing-api
  20:38  Fix rounding error in invoice totals

  Next
    Nov 15  3X0XK8AQ  Add a regression test for tax rounding  [billing-api]
```

### MCP

Resolve an open next item. Pass the short id.

```json
{
  "id": "3X0XK8AQ"
}
```

The text result:

```text
Entry 3X0XK8AQ resolved: Add a regression test for tax rounding
```

The structured result:

```json
{
  "entry": {
    "id": "01M7G81PPMZGP2E3X73X0XK8AQ",
```
